C0137.title: Black-market gang offering discounted membership top-ups dismantled by police
C0137.summary: In October 2023, Hangzhou cyber police uncovered a black-market gang exploiting a vulnerability in Apple's in-app purchase mechanism to sell discounted membership services, offering subscriptions originally priced at nearly 300 yuan for half the cost. The gang illegally sold 59,339 pieces of personal information before being taken down.
